text_block_list.text:
When Vodka failed to show up for practice
even after the scheduled time, I went searching for her—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit,
I was so close, too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guess I pushed it too hard on that corner.
Next time, I'll need to ease off the throttle a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, it was fun playing games for the first time in a while.
Man, I wanna ride a real motorcycle soon, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer?!
Why are you in a place like this...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, Trainer.
I was just about to beat the high score, so I got totally hooked...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll be careful next time!
See yaaaaa!

I managed to catch Vodka right as she tried
to run off, and gave her a proper scolding.
